tasks.request: Vacuum/degenerate-parabolic existence theory for the Binard-Degond-Noble water-bed-sediment system, including global time behavior
not_delivered: General finite-energy domains and boundary conditions
Uniqueness/compactness estimates surviving vanishing water depth
General global-in-time well-posedness or a full-system viscosity formulation
tasks.next_proof_obligation: Specify an admissible full-system weak/viscosity solution concept, obtain uniform estimates for h and hc without dividing by h, and prove compactness and uniqueness or a sharp counterexample.

tasks.request: Existence and regularity of steady stream-power-plus-diffusion landscapes coupled to contributing area
not_delivered: Uniqueness beyond the constant-forcing, small-K, flow-margin multiplier class
Arbitrary mixed or single-outlet boundary conditions
Certified exact nonradial PDE branch or invariant-ball membership for the collocation experiment
tasks.next_proof_obligation: For arbitrary K, establish a priori bounds that close the nonlinear elliptic/transport fixed point, or prove a precise nonexistence result. The critical-set criterion alone does not do this.

tasks.request: Díaz et al. fixed-coefficient reduced model for suitable strictly positive initial data decaying at infinity
not_delivered: Existence for the stated strictly positive infinite-support initial class
A counterexample excluding every suitable positive decaying datum
A proof that a front cannot enter from infinity
An equivalence proof between all printed strong-local and global measure formulations
tasks.next_proof_obligation: Fix the solution class and interface measure precisely; prove fixed-coefficient existence with the required integral constraint, or a theorem excluding that class. The repaired profile and elementary rescaling do not close this obligation.
